name: Preserve original evidence
steps: Write-block the source media; never boot the original disk r/w.
Image with verified hashes (SHA-256) before and after acquisition; record hash values.
For live systems: capture memory first, then acquire logical files (hiberfil.sys, pagefile, unallocated where feasible).
Disable backup overwrites; snapshot cloud VM volumes before further access.
Keep the original evidence byte-for-byte untouched; work only on copies.
tools: FTK Imager, dd/ewfacquire, Guymager, cloud snapshot APIs
notes: The verified hash is the single most challenged item in court — record both source and copy hashes.
